tests.name: ledger completion route rejects the probe on staging (enforce; VTID-PROBE is not a VTID, so a gateway without the pin answers 400 before any database call)

tests.reason: The change is the production deploy step that sets LEDGER_WRITE_AUTH_MODE; this suite runs that step's shell on a fixture task definition (unset gives log, enforce gives enforce), proves an anonymous allocate gets 401 with nothing allocated, and proves the VTID-PROBE probe is rejected before any I/O in every mode. Production is never probed.
